# Fixture: malformed /proc/<pid>/cgroup records.
# Known behavior: parse_cgroup_subsystems splits on ':' and requires exactly
# three parts; every line below is silently dropped.
# Line 1: cgroup v2 line with an extra colon in the path (four parts).
0::/user.slice/session:c1.scope
# Line 2: v1 line missing the path field (two parts).
8:memory
# Line 3: v1 line with an empty controller list and colon in path (five parts).
0::/a:b:c
